verificationSummary: Editor commit 58f3002363b29662bb02042fdb1021236844cbc1 implements the bounded smooth viewport zoom surface. PaperZoomControls adds Zoom out, current zoom, presets for 50%, 85%, 100%, and 125%, and Zoom in under the toolbar label Canvas zoom (viewport only). PaperPage marks the paper shell as viewport-only and the paper page as smooth zoom motion; editor.css transitions transform for 160ms and disables motion under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. CanvasOverlayLayer schedules post-transition selection overlay sync so the selected-node overlay is remeasured after zoom motion settles. Focused RED failed because src/tests/paperSmoothZoomSurface.test.ts expected Canvas zoom (viewport only), viewport-only paper markers, presets, and smooth motion before implementation, and because src/tests/selectionOverlay.test.ts expected a post-transition overlay sync helper before it existed. Focused GREEN passed src/tests/paperSmoothZoomSurface.test.ts and src/tests/selectionOverlay.test.ts with 2 files and 9 tests. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 88 passed test files, 302 passed tests, and build. npm run dev:local-loopback:smoke passed in the Editor worktree with Backend and Editor on random loopback ports while Core remained dependency-only. A Chromium browser check in live Backend mode opened /documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design, observed Backend GET /capabilities/versions and GET /documents/product-report-vnext-minimal at 200, confirmed Source: Backend read and Authoring: limited, clicked Zoom in from 85% to 95%, confirmed transform transition 0.16s, found no Backend mutation requests, and measured selected title overlay deltas near zero after motion settled. Merged Editor main npm run check passed type-check, 88 passed test files, 302 passed tests, and build. Editor npm install still reports 5 high severity vulnerabilities, Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning, Backend /health still reports production blocked, and the primary Core checkout still has unrelated deleted pdf-renderer-pilot fixture files. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor smooth viewport zoom lane and does not promote broad Editor truth, command readiness, WYSIWYG readiness, text input readiness, Backend readiness, Core truth, live production behavior, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, bundle-size readiness, or FlowDoc product readiness.
